column_description: Unique identifier for each rendering configuration.
Name of the rendering configuration. may be NULL.
Rendering technique used (e.g., raytracing, rasterization). always exactly one of 'raytracing', 'rasterization'. may be NULL.
Quality of the rendering (e.g., low, medium, high). always exactly one of 'low', 'medium', 'high'. may be NULL.
Resolution of the rendered image (width, height). may be NULL.
Number of samples per pixel for anti-aliasing. may be NULL.
Maximum number of light bounces for global illumination. may be NULL.
Denoiser used (e.g., no denoiser, OpenImageDenoise). always exactly one of 'no denoiser', 'OpenImageDenoise'. may be NULL.
Version of the rendering settings. may be NULL.
Creation date and time of the rendering settings. may be NULL.
Last update date and time of the rendering settings. may be NULL.
ID of the user who created the rendering settings. may be NULL.
ID of the user who last updated the rendering settings. may be NULL.
